svg.text: 16×16 spatial cells × 8 luminance bins; per cell: 8 curves × RGB + 3×4 colour matrix
ℒ = ℒchar(Î, Y) + 0.25(1 − SSIM) + 0.05 ‖ℱ(Î) − ℱ(Y)‖1 + 0.5 ℒaux(Îg, Y)
Each pixel reads its coefficients from the 8
nearest cells (trilinear), at its spatial position
and learned luminance. The global branch only
sees a 256² thumbnail, so its cost is the same
SimpleGate(X) = X₁ ⊙ X₂; SCA = channel attention via GAP + 1×1; no non-linear activations (Chen et al., 2022)
